_comment: klt erc supply spec for `pll_pfd` (T1 item 11, analog partition; issue #147).
Input: layout/sg13cmos5l-pll/reports/20261003-183059-dc5644a/pll_pfd.gds (top cell pll_pfd).
Run (repo root): klt erc <gds> <this spec> --top pll_pfd --deck sg13cmos5l --format json
-- see the dated ERC record's run-erc.sh for the exact pinned build.
Supplies (subckt port list): VDD, VSS. LVS pairs VDD->VDD and VSS->VSS (pin: true).
Body rails in the reference: every pfet body on VDD, every nfet body on VSS.
Stackup/vias: GatPoly (5/0, gate role, active_layer Activ 1/0) -> Metal1
(8/0) -> Metal2 (10/0) -> Metal3 (30/0) -> Metal4 (50/0), bridged by Cont
(6/0), Via1 (19/0), Via2 (29/0), Via3 (49/0). Same layer numbers and the
same dual-source provenance (sg13cmos5l.lyp + the curated sg13cmos5l deck
LAYER_NAMES table) as ../erc-supply-spec.json, extended by Metal4/Via3
because the MoM capacitors (Recog.mom 99/39) are drawn on Metal1..Metal4;
a declared layer the block does not draw is not an error (docs/cli/erc.md).
Label text is read from Metal1.pin (8/2) and Metal3.pin (30/2) -- the only
metal pin layers carrying text in these streams (Metal3.pin holds
cmos5l_route.py's one-per-net trunk label).
Run with `--deck sg13cmos5l` so the deck's own rppd/rhigh/rsil body regions
(GatPoly & PolyRes & ...) are carved out of the gatpoly role: a drawn
resistor body is a device, not a wire (docs/cli/erc.md, 'Device bodies
are not wires'). MoM capacitors are NOT carved (MomCapacitorDevice is not
matched by --deck at this build); their two finger sets are disjoint
geometry, so they cannot merge two nets in this model.
Supplies: every top-level supply port of design/sg13cmos5l/netlist/<block>.spice
(DR-004 rail table), cross-checked against the same-GDS LVS net_correspondence in
layout/sg13cmos5l-pll/reports/20261003-183059-dc5644a/lvs.<block>.json. `expected_islands` is this repo's annotation (klt
erc ignores unknown keys): 1 means exactly one electrical island, which is
the only outcome without an erc.unconnected_net finding.
Tie `nwell_tap` (2 merged NWell shapes, one per pfet group: pfd_pfet_w5_l0p5, pfd_pfet_w10_l0p5):
the curated deck derives a well tie as nSD & Activ & NWell (klayout-tools#1414).
Declared as tap_layer Cont (6/0) narrowed by tap_requires [nSD 7/0, Activ 1/0]
inside each drawn NWell (31/0) -- this excludes every pfet source/drain
contact (pSD 14/0 Activ), so the narrowing removes real geometry and the
tie is graded checked, not skipped-degenerate (klayout-tools#2199). Each
NWell shape must independently hold a tap reaching VDD. Drawn well:
physically checked.
Tie `substrate_tap`: this stream draws NO p-well/substrate polygon (no 46/0,
no 40/0), so the nfet bodies sit in the bare global p-substrate. Declared
with well_layer null + well_boxes (klayout-tools#2255): one box per nfet
group cell, = that instance's bounding box in the GDS rounded outward to
0.01 um (pfd_nfet_w2_l0p5, pfd_nfet_w4_l0p5). The tap is Cont (6/0) narrowed by tap_requires [pSD
14/0, Activ 1/0] (the deck's pSD & (Activ - NWell) substrate tie; it excludes
the nfet source/drain contacts, which have no pSD, and the poly resistor head
contacts, which have no Activ). Each asserted box must independently hold a
tap reaching VSS. LIMIT: this is checked_by_well_assertion -- the region
is the caller's word, not a drawn well, and is weaker evidence than the
drawn-NWell tie above. The substrate under the resistors/MoM caps is not
asserted (those devices have no MOS body; rppd/rhigh bulk is the global
substrate per the reference netlist).
